cues: Tilt Rolle's picture and you get the Mean Value Theorem.
Join the ends of the curve with a chord.
Somewhere in between, a tangent runs exactly parallel to that chord: f dash of c equals the chord's slope.
If you drive sixty kilometres in an hour, at some instant your speedometer read exactly sixty.
